name: json2dir-csharp-fast
description: Performance-focused C# (.NET 10): SIMD lexer over raw UTF-8 bytes, in-place zero-copy strings, flat node array, *at() syscalls via libc P/Invoke; self-contained ReadyToRun with a static PGO profile
build:
export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1 NUGET_PACKAGES={runtimes}/dotnet-tools/nuget
# .NET 10 SDK from WSL (/usr/bin/dotnet); runtime pack and crossgen2 are restored into runtimes/dotnet-tools/nuget.
dotnet publish -c Release --nologo -v quiet -o {src}/out {src}/json2dir-fast.csproj
